selection_policy: Primary specifications and official project documentation for portable schemas, deterministic serialization, hashing/MAC, key derivation and encrypted export packaging.

sources.title: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
limitations: Does not define semantic compatibility, canonical byte representation or migration behavior

sources.title: RFC 8785 — JSON Canonicalization Scheme
supports: I-JSON constraints and recursive property sorting
limitations: Informational RFC, not IETF Standards Track

sources.title: RFC 8949 — CBOR
limitations: Binary representation reduces direct human inspection and is unnecessary for current M0 payload size

sources.title: Protocol Buffers — Serialization Is Not Canonical
supports: protobuf deterministic serialization is not canonical
serialized protobuf bytes are unsuitable as stable long-term fingerprints
limitations: Does not reduce Protobuf's value for future typed transport/binding use

sources.title: FIPS 180-4 — Secure Hash Standard
limitations: Unkeyed digest does not authenticate against an attacker who can alter both data and digest

sources.title: FIPS 198-1 — HMAC
supports: keyed message authentication using secure hash functions
limitations: NIST plans to migrate the content into SP 800-224
security depends on key remaining separate from attacker-controlled state

sources.title: NIST SP 800-224 Initial Public Draft — HMAC
supports: current NIST transition direction for HMAC guidance
limitations: Initial public draft is not final

sources.title: RFC 5869 — HKDF
supports: derive independent subkeys from one master key using labeled info contexts

sources.title: age
limitations: Key/recovery policy remains an Aurora concern

sources.title: filippo.io/age Go package
supports: current Go implementation of age format
limitations: Package API does not define Aurora export semantics
